definitions.output_failure: Two unusable final outputs; no replacement action
definitions.native_terminal_unknown: SDK terminated normally while native minitask verdict remained unknown
definitions.step_limit: Reached 2000 submitted actions while native outcome unresolved
definitions.unchanged_action_repeat: Same action and task-relevant state repeated consecutively; context review required
definitions.low_score_settlement: Native failure immediately after choosing build_city with score below goal
definitions.native_deadline_reached: Native failure at or after the recorded native turn deadline
definitions.transported_unit_no_longer_observed: A carried own unit disappeared without an observed city creation; inspect native messages
definitions.success_without_loaded_ship_move: Native success with no observed movement of a loaded ship
definitions.available_goal_settlement_deferred: Goal met and build_city legal, but another action selected; context review required
definitions.unit_disappearance_during_food_deficit: Own unit disappeared over END_TURN while a visible own city had negative food surplus; causal interpretation requires review
